401 Unauthorized error on OCR request due to invalid API credentials

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { OcrDocument, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  try {
    await client.ocr({ document: { type: "document_url", url: "https://example.com/doc.pdf" } as OcrDocument, model: "mistral/mistral-ocr-latest" });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      console.error(`${error.name}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

void main();
```
